milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the green terracotta wall and face it to observe it. The green terracotta wall is at spawn-relative z=2, spanning x=-2 to x=4, with the doorway at x=0-1. Target [1, 1, 2] is the center of the wall at eye level. max_distance=5 is appropriate since the player spawns at z=0 and needs to look toward z=2.

Uses inventory_has because when gravel is mined it drops itself as an item (90% chance) or flint (10% chance). With 18 gravel blocks available in the barrier (3 deep × 2 wide × 3 high), the player must mine multiple blocks to clear a path, making it virtually certain (>99.8%) that at least one gravel item will drop. The iron pickaxe provided can mine gravel instantly.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to the ender chest beyond the gravel barrier and face it. The ender chest is at spawn-relative [1, 0, 12]. max_distance=5 ensures the player must have passed through the gravel barrier (which ends at z=7) to be close enough, correctly enforcing the dependency on mining gravel first.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because brown stained glass pane drops NOTHING when mined without Silk Touch, so inventory_has cannot be used. Instead we verify that at least one of the 18 placed panes (9 per wall: 3 z-positions × 3 y-heights at x=-2 and x=4, z=11-13, y=1-3) has been removed. The box [-3, 0, 10] to [5, 4, 14] encloses all pane locations with generous margins. max_count=17 means at least 1 of the 18 original panes was mined.
